# Test Report: PR #5839 feat: per-user throttle tier and signup bot checks **Branch:** `feat/shadow-throttle-tier` → `main` **Author:** jarlacut **Preview:** https://app.pr5839.preview.bike4mind.com **Build under test:** deployed `00ddc627b` (the PR's last feature commit, "fix(throttle): enforce restricted models across tools and subagents"). Head `11ae4cf58` is a main merge on top of it with no further PR changes, and it was not yet deployed during the run · CI **SUCCESS** (33 pass, 8 skipping, 0 failing at report time) **Date:** 2026-10-28 ## Overall result: ✅ PASS **Step 4 is ⚠️ BLOCKED on this preview by design.** In `otc/send`, `collectSignupSignals` returns no signals when `isE2EEnabled()` is true. `E2E_ENDPOINTS_ENABLED=true` is set on every preview, so a honeypot signup cannot become shadowed here. The guide itself says steps 1-4 need a stage where signup checks are active. On the preview I confirmed the client side of the honeypot path: the hidden field, `formToken` and `formExtra:"x"` are all sent, and the response and signup flow are identical. The server side (signals stored, tier set, audit row written) is not shown live. Every other step passed. That makes 11 of 13 guide steps PASS (step 3 is the setup action for step 4), plus the Register-page regression. The admin can set and clear the tier with one audit entry each, and an empty or short reason returns 400. The shadowed user gets an identical 429 after 3 requests a minute. A premium model (Claude Sonnet 5) stays selected and names itself, while the turn bills about 2 credits against 11 for a normal user, which points to substitution. The daily token cap returns the same out-of-credits message a low-balance user sees, and clearing the tier restores normal limits on the next request. **No bugs found in this PR.** One gap: the `llm-usage-settled` server log in step 10 could not be read (no log access from QA), so the substitution evidence is the credit cost.
Accounts used | Account | Role | Used for | |---|---|---| | `qa-admin-e2e@test.com` | Admin | Admin -> Users (Full view) Shadow tier set/clear, audit log, settings, credit set for comparison | | `qa-pr5839-s1-e2e@test.com` (new, UI signup) | Normal (Customer tag) | Step 1 normal signup; shadowed user for steps 5-13 | | `qa-pr5839-s3-e2e@test.com` (new, UI signup) | Normal (Customer tag) | Step 3 honeypot signup; unshadowed comparison user (429 body, Sonnet cost, low-credit error) | | `qa-pr5839-reg-e2e@test.com` (new, Register page) | Normal | Regression: Register-page signup | `qa-user-e2e@test.com` was **not** used as the shadowed user, because it carries the `developer` tag and the PR exempts developer-tagged users from shadowing. Login: E2E one-time-code flow via `/api/test/otc-code` (8-digit codes). Each user ran in its own browser context.
Results by step (1-13) Status emoji: ✅ PASS · ❌ FAIL · ⚠️ BLOCKED · ⚪ N/A · ➖ NOT TESTED. ### ✅ Step 1 - Normal-pace OTC signup - On `/login` the honeypot is present: `div[aria-hidden=true][data-testid=signup-honeypot] > input[name=hp_ref_x]`, `tabIndex -1`, `autocomplete=off`, positioned at x=-10000. - `GET /api/otc/form-token` fires on page load. I typed the email at about 90 ms per key and waited before Continue. `otc/send` body: `{"email":..., "formToken":"eyJhbGciOiJI...", "formExtra":""}`. - Verify code -> "Finish creating your account" -> username + 2 policy boxes -> Create account -> landed on `/new`. Same flow as before. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-01-signup-normal-complete.png` ### ✅ Step 2 - New user is not shadowed - Admin -> Users, search `qa-pr5839`, **Full** view -> Admin Actions: "Shadow tier" is **unchecked** for `qapr5839s1`. - API: no `throttle` and no `riskSignals` on the user. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-02-04-admin-full-view-shadow-unchecked.png` (signup IPs masked) ### ✅ Step 3 - Honeypot filled via the guide's console snippet - In a fresh context I ran the guide's snippet on `/login`, then signed up `qa-pr5839-s3-e2e@test.com`. - `otc/send` body carried `"formExtra":"x"` with a valid `formToken`. The response and UI were identical ("Verification code sent!", same code screen), and signup completed to `/new`. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-03-honeypot-filled-code-screen.png`, `B4M-5839-03b-honeypot-signup-complete.png` ### ⚠️ Step 4 - Honeypot user shadowed (source `signup_honeypot`) - BLOCKED (environment) - As expected on a preview: "Shadow tier" is **unchecked** for `qapr5839s3`, the user has no `throttle` or `riskSignals`, and there is no `user.throttle_tier.changed` entry for it. - Cause: `apps/client/pages/api/otc/send.ts` `collectSignupSignals` has `if (isE2EEnabled()) return [];`, and every preview runs with E2E enabled. This matches the guide's note that steps 1-4 need a stage where signup checks are active. Retest on that stage. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-02-04-admin-full-view-shadow-unchecked.png` ### ✅ Step 5 - Admin sets Shadow tier with a reason - Admin -> Users -> Full view -> `qapr5839s1` -> Admin Actions -> checked **Shadow tier**. The reason input (`admin-user-shadow-reason-input`) appeared. With the reason empty, **Update is disabled**. - Reason `QA PR5839 shadow tier test` -> Update -> `PUT /api/users//update {"throttleTier":"shadow","throttleReason":"..."}` -> **200**, toast "Profile updated successfully". - Read-only info after save: "Tier shadow, source admin, changed 2026-10-28." - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-05-shadow-checked-reason-filled.png`, `B4M-5839-06a-empty-reason-update.png`, `B4M-5839-06b-shadow-saved-info.png` ### ✅ Step 6 - Audit entry, no-op re-update, empty reason - One `user.throttle_tier.changed` entry (category access, severity **critical**), changes `throttle.tier` before `none` -> after `shadow`, with the reason. No `user.profile.updated` was logged alongside it. - After the save the Update button disappears because the form is no longer dirty, so I replayed "Update again with no change" through the API: `PUT {throttleTier:"shadow", throttleReason:...}` -> 200, and **no new audit entry** (still exactly one for this user). - Empty reason `""` -> **400** "A reason of at least 5 characters is required". `"abc"` -> 400 with the same message. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-06c-audit-log-throttle-entry.png`, `B4M-5839-06b-shadow-saved-info.png` ### ✅ Step 7-8 - Shadow rpm: 200, 200, 200, then 429 - As the shadowed user, `GET /api/v1/projects` five times within about 2 s: **200, 200, 200, 429 (Retry-After 59), 429 (Retry-After 58)**. Body: `{"name":"TooManyRequestsError","error":"Rate limit exceeded. Try again in 59 seconds."}`. - Comparison: the unshadowed `qapr5839s3` hit its limit after **10** requests and got the identical body shape and `Retry-After` header (`"Rate limit exceeded. Try again in 56 seconds."`). - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-07-08-shadow-rpm-429.png`, `B4M-5839-08b-normal-user-429-comparison.png` ### ✅ Step 9-10 - Premium model selected, silent substitution - Pre-check: `GET /api/v1/models` lists `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` (allowlist = `gpt-5.4-nano`, `gemini-3.1-flash-lite`). `gpt-5.4-nano` is not in the preview catalog. - As the shadowed user, with **Claude Sonnet 5** selected, I sent "Hello, how are you?". The reply was normal, and the UI still showed Claude Sonnet 5 on the message and in the model button. The `/api/ai/llm` request carried the selected model. - "Which model are you?" -> "I am Claude Sonnet 5 (model id global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5)." - Substitution evidence: each shadowed turn cost **2 credits** (10000 -> 9998 -> 9996). The same "Hello, how are you?" on Claude Sonnet 5 from the unshadowed `qapr5839s3` cost **11 credits**, and after the tier was cleared the shadowed user's own Sonnet turn cost **47**. - Not verified: the server `llm-usage-settled` log line, because QA has no log access. The credit cost above stands in for it. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-09-shadow-chat-hello.png`, `B4M-5839-10-shadow-which-model.png`, `B4M-5839-10b-normal-user-sonnet-cost-comparison.png` ### ✅ Step 11-12 - Daily token cap -> native insufficient-credits error - Admin Settings -> `shadowTierDailyTokenCap` 20000 -> **1000** (saved; row confirmed 1000). - The next three shadowed turns (02:28-02:30 UTC) still answered. This matches the documented 5-minute per-process admin-settings cache (`b4m-core/utils/src/settings.ts`). The first turn after the cache window (02:33:48) was refused. - Shadowed user (real balance 9,988): **"You're out of credits. This request needs about 322 credits, but only 0 are available. Add credits to keep going."** + Top up / Get Pro. - Reference, a real low-balance user (`qapr5839s3` set to 10 credits): **"You're out of credits. This request needs about 675 credits, but only 10 are available. Add credits to keep going."** + Top up / Get Pro. Same message and same buttons. At exactly 0 credits the client hides the input and shows an "Out of Credits" panel, so the server message was compared at 10 credits. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-11-daily-token-cap-1000.png`, `B4M-5839-12-shadow-daily-cap-error.png`, `B4M-5839-12b-free-user-low-credits-reference.png`, `B4M-5839-12b-free-user-zero-credits-reference.png` ### ✅ Step 13 - Clear the tier -> normal limits on the next request - Unchecked Shadow tier, reason `QA PR5839 clear shadow tier`, clicked Update -> 200, toast. Audit: one new `user.throttle_tier.changed` entry, before `shadow` -> after `none`. - Right after: `GET /api/v1/projects` x6 -> **all 200** (above the shadow rpm of 3). A chat turn on Claude Sonnet 5 answered normally and cost **47 credits** (real Sonnet pricing), with no cap error. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-13a-uncheck-shadow-reason.png`, `B4M-5839-13b-after-clear-normal-limits.png` ### Regression checks - ✅ **Register page signup:** `/register` has the honeypot and fetches the form token. `otc/send` sent `formToken` + `formExtra:""`, and Create Account landed on `/new`. **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-R-register-form.png`, `B4M-5839-R-register-signup-complete.png` - ✅ **Login-page signup:** steps 1 and 3. - ✅ **Normal user rate limit + model selection:** the unshadowed user's limit stays at 10/min, and Sonnet 5 billed at the normal price (11 credits). - ✅ **Fields hidden from self view:** `GET /api/users/` as the user has no `throttle` and no `riskSignals` keys. - ➖ **API-key rate-limit headers:** NOT TESTED (no personal key minted this run). - ⚠️ **OAuth login:** BLOCKED. It needs real Google/GitHub credentials, which previews don't have.
Findings **Bugs in this PR** None. **Pre-existing issues (not caused by this PR)** None. **Observations** - **The guide's navigation is outdated after main's Users-page overhaul.** On the Users list the row's **Admin** button now opens the `/admin/users/` profile page, which has no Shadow tier control. The control is only reachable by switching the list's display mode to **Full** (Admin Actions -> Shadow tier). Suggest updating the guide to "Admin -> Users -> view mode Full -> Admin Actions". - **Missing reason returns a misleading message.** `PUT /api/users//update {"throttleTier":"none"}` with no `throttleReason` key returns 400 "This page is running an outdated version of the app. Reload the page and try again." An empty or short reason returns the clear "A reason of at least 5 characters is required". This is probably deliberate (it treats an old client as stale), but an API caller sees confusing copy. Minor. - **Guide step 6 "click Update again":** after a save the Update button is hidden because the form is no longer dirty, so the UI can't re-submit an unchanged form. The no-op path was verified through the API. - **The daily-cap message prices at the requested model** ("needs about 322 credits"). This matches the PR's "Known limits" on pricing for substituted turns. - **Cap changes take up to 5 minutes to apply**, because of the per-process admin-settings cache. The PR is not at fault, but testers lowering the cap should wait out the window. - `/api/otc/form-token` is fetched twice per page load on `/login` and `/register` (dev StrictMode or two mounts). It is harmless and below the IP limit.
Cleanup / environment left in this state - Users created: `qa-pr5839-s1-e2e@test.com` (tier now `none`, two audit rows), `qa-pr5839-s3-e2e@test.com` (credits set to 0, then 10, then restored to 10,000, with credit-change audit rows), `qa-pr5839-reg-e2e@test.com`. - `shadowTierDailyTokenCap` lowered to 1000 and **restored to 20000**. - No Shadow tier left set on any account I touched.
